---
title: "What changed between PLACES 2024 and 2025"
---

Every measure for one county, both PLACES releases side by side, largest
absolute change first. Press **Run** to execute it in your browser against the
latest release. Denver County, CO (`county:08031`) is an ordinary county:

```{.sql .runnable}
SELECT o25.measure_id,
       o24.value AS v2024, o25.value AS v2025,
       round(o25.value - o24.value, 2) AS delta
FROM measure.observation o24
JOIN measure.observation o25
  ON o24.measure_id = o25.measure_id AND o24.geo_id = o25.geo_id
  AND o24.stratum_id = o25.stratum_id
WHERE o24.source = 'PLACES' AND o24.source_release = '2024'
  AND o25.source = 'PLACES' AND o25.source_release = '2025'
  AND o24.geo_id = 'county:08031' AND o25.geo_id = 'county:08031'
  AND o24.value IS NOT NULL AND o25.value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY abs(delta) DESC
LIMIT 15
```

South Central Connecticut Planning Region (`county:09170`) is the other kind.
Connecticut's PLACES rows use 2022-vintage planning-region FIPS even though
PLACES tags them `geo_vintage=2020` (see
[Concepts › Time axes](/concepts/time-axes.qmd) and
[cancer-basemap#21](https://github.com/seandavi/cancer-basemap/issues/21)), so
the same query works on it unchanged:

```{.sql .runnable}
SELECT o25.measure_id,
       o24.value AS v2024, o25.value AS v2025,
       round(o25.value - o24.value, 2) AS delta
FROM measure.observation o24
JOIN measure.observation o25
  ON o24.measure_id = o25.measure_id AND o24.geo_id = o25.geo_id
  AND o24.stratum_id = o25.stratum_id
WHERE o24.source = 'PLACES' AND o24.source_release = '2024'
  AND o25.source = 'PLACES' AND o25.source_release = '2025'
  AND o24.geo_id = 'county:09170' AND o25.geo_id = 'county:09170'
  AND o24.value IS NOT NULL AND o25.value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY abs(delta) DESC
LIMIT 15
```

Both filter on the one `geo_id` twice so DuckDB reads only that state's part
of `measure.observation`. Swap in any other county's `geo_id` (5-digit FIPS
after `county:`) to compare it.
